limitations: Research only: within-person statistical deviation is not a diagnosis, condition label, probability, severity or risk.
Comparisons use only this subject's own declared reference period; no population norm or universal normal range is applied.
All statistical parameters are configurable research defaults, not validated clinical, NASA-approved or operational limits.
Indicators are reported separately and never combined into a composite score.
Change relative to a reference period does not establish a cause; isolation, confinement or any other factor is not inferred as the reason.
Missing, invalid or unavailable records are preserved as abstentions or exclusions, never treated as normal values.
No recommendation, treatment or operational action is produced; outputs require qualified human review.

time_convention: Each entry dated D is a daily self-report anchored at 12:00 UTC on D. Sleep duration covers the 24 hours ending at that report, (D-1 12:00, D 12:00] UTC; fatigue is a point report at 12:00 UTC. The last assessment_days dated entries form the assessment period; earlier dates form the personal reference period, declared at least as long as the research parameters need.
